## 2. Statement of Facts

Trishul Ventures Private Limited held unlisted equity shares of Vantage Systems Private Limited for 30 months before selling them to Galewind Capital Partners LLP, realising a gain of INR 42 crore.

## 3. Issue for Consideration

Whether the gain on sale of the unlisted shares is long-term or short-term, and the applicable tax rate under Section 112 following the amendments made by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024.

## 4. Relevant Legal Framework

- Section 2(29A) / 2(42A)
- Section 112
- Section 48


## 5. Judicial Precedents Considered

- Not applicable / no specific provisions beyond the Income-tax Act general scheme.

## 6. Analysis

As the holding period of 30 months exceeds the 24-month threshold prescribed for unlisted shares to qualify as long-term capital assets, the gain is a long-term capital gain. Following the withdrawal of the indexation benefit for transfers effected on or after 23 July 2024, the gain is computed under Section 48 without indexation and taxed under Section 112 at the revised rate applicable to long-term gains on unlisted shares.

## 7. Conclusion / Opinion

The gain of INR 42 crore is a long-term capital gain, taxable under Section 112 at 12.5% without the benefit of indexation.

**Confidence level:** High
